sentences.en: Adults and children are frequently confronted with statements about the alarming rate of loss of tropical rainforests.
sentences.zh: 成人和儿童经常面临热带雨林损失速度惊人的说法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For example, one graphic illustration to which children might readily relate is the estimate that rainforests are being destroyed at a rate equivalent to one thousand football fields every forty minutes – about the duration of a normal classroom period.
sentences.zh: 例如,儿童可能很容易接触到的一个图表说明是,雨林被破坏的速度相当于每40分钟1000个足球场,也就是正常教室的时段。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In the face of the frequent and often vivid media coverage, it is likely that children will have formed ideas about rainforests – what and where they are, why they are important, what endangers them – independent of any formal tuition.
sentences.zh: 面对媒体经常和经常生动的报道,儿童们很可能已经形成关于雨林的想法 — — 雨林是什么和在哪里,为什么它们是重要的,什么会危及它们 — — 而不考虑任何正式的学费。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: It is also possible that some of these ideas will be mistaken.
sentences.zh: 其中一些想法也可能被误解。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Many studies have shown that children harbour misconceptions about ‘pure’, curriculum science.
sentences.zh: 许多研究表明,儿童对`纯净 ' 、课程科学持有误解。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: These misconceptions do not remain isolated but become incorporated into a multifaceted, but organised, conceptual framework, making it and the component ideas, some of which are erroneous, more robust but also accessible to modification.
sentences.zh: 这些误解并非孤立存在,而是被纳入一个多层次的、有条理的概念框架,使它和组成部分的概念成为一体,其中一些是错误的,更加有力,但也可以修改。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: These ideas may be developed by children absorbing ideas through the popular media.
sentences.zh: 这些想法可以通过大众传媒吸收思想的儿童来发展。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Sometimes this information may be erroneous.
sentences.zh: 有时,这种信息可能是错误的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It seems schools may not be providing an opportunity for children to re-express their ideas and so have them tested and refined by teachers and their peers.
sentences.zh: 看来学校可能没有为儿童重新表达自己的想法提供机会,教师和同龄人测试和完善他们的想法也有机会。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Despite the extensive coverage in the popular media of the destruction of rainforests, little formal information is available about children’s ideas in this area.
sentences.zh: 尽管大众传媒广泛报道雨林被毁,但关于儿童在这方面的想法,几乎没有正式资料。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The aim of the present study is to start to provide such information, to help teachers design their educational strategies to build upon correct ideas and to displace misconceptions and to plan programmes in environmental studies in their schools.
sentences.zh: 本研究报告的目的是开始提供这种资料,帮助教师设计教育战略,以正确的想法为基础,消除误解,并规划学校环境研究方案。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The study surveys children’s scientific knowledge and attitudes to rainforests.
sentences.zh: 这项研究调查了儿童对雨林的科学知识和态度。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Secondary school children were asked to complete a questionnaire containing five open-form questions.
sentences.zh: 要求中学生填写一份问卷,其中列出五个开放形式问题。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The most frequent responses to the first question were descriptions which are self-evident from the term ‘rainforest’.
sentences.zh: 对第一个问题最经常的答复是说明,从 " 森林 " 一词来看,这些说明是不言自明的。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Some children described them as damp, wet or hot.
sentences.zh: 一些儿童称他们潮湿、湿或热。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The second question concerned the geographical location of rainforests.
sentences.zh: 第二个问题涉及雨林的地理位置。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The commonest responses were continents or countries: Africa (given by 43% of children), South America (30%), Brazil (25%).
sentences.zh: 最常见的答复是大陆或国家:非洲(43%的儿童)、南美洲(30%)、巴西(25%)。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Some children also gave more general locations, such as being near the Equator.
sentences.zh: 一些儿童还提供了更一般的地点,例如靠近赤道。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Responses to question three concerned the importance of rainforests.
sentences.zh: 对问题3的答复涉及雨林的重要性。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The dominant idea, raised by 64% of the pupils, was that rainforests provide animals with habitats.
sentences.zh: 占学生64%的主导思想是雨林为动物提供栖息地。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Fewer students responded that rainforests provide plant habitats, and even fewer mentioned the indigenous populations of rainforests.
sentences.zh: 回答雨林提供植物生境的学生较少,提到雨林土著人口的人数更少。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: More girls (70%) than boys (60%) raised the idea of rainforest as animal habitats.
sentences.zh: 女孩(70%)比男孩(60%)多,她们把雨林视为动物栖息地。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Similarly, but at a lower level, more girls (13%) than boys (5%) said that rainforests provided human habitats.
sentences.zh: 同样,在较低层次,女孩(13%)比男孩(5%)说雨林提供了人类生境,但女孩(5%)说,雨林提供了人类生境。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: These observations are generally consistent with our previous studies of pupils’ views about the use and conservation of rainforests, in which girls were shown to be more sympathetic to animals and expressed views which seem to place an intrinsic value on non-human animal life.
sentences.zh: 这些观察与我们以前对学生关于使用和保护雨林的看法的研究基本一致,在研究中,女孩对动物更同情,并表达了似乎对非人类动物生命具有内在价值的观点。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The fourth question concerned the causes of the destruction of rainforests.
sentences.zh: 第四个问题涉及雨林被毁的原因。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Perhaps encouragingly, more than half of the pupils (59%) identified that it is human activities which are destroying rainforests, some personalising the responsibility by the use of terms such as ‘we are’.
sentences.zh: 半数以上的学生(59%)认为人类活动正在摧毁雨林, 有些学生使用「我们」等词汇, 将责任个人化,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: About 18% of the pupils referred specifically to logging activity.
sentences.zh: 大约18%的学生具体提到伐木活动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: One misconception, expressed by some 10% of the pupils, was that acid rain is responsible for rainforest destruction; a similar proportion said that pollution is destroying rainforests.
sentences.zh: 大约10%的学生表示一种误解,认为酸雨是雨林被毁的原因;同样比例的学生说,污染正在摧毁雨林。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Here, children are confusing rainforest destruction with damage to the forests of Western Europe by these factors.
sentences.zh: 在这里,儿童们把雨林的破坏与这些因素对西欧森林的破坏混淆起来。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: While two fifths of the students provided the information that the rainforests provide oxygen, in some cases this response also embraced the misconception that rainforest destruction would reduce atmospheric oxygen, making the atmosphere incompatible with human life on Earth.
sentences.zh: 五分之一的学生提供了雨林提供氧气的信息,但在某些情况下,这种反应也包含了一种误解,即雨林的破坏会减少大气氧气,使大气层与地球上的人类生命不相容。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: In answer to the final question about the importance of rainforest conservation, the majority of children simply said that we need rainforests to survive.
sentences.zh: 在回答关于雨林养护重要性的最后问题时,大多数儿童只是说我们需要雨林生存。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Only a few of the pupils (6%) mentioned that rainforest destruction may contribute to global warming.
sentences.zh: 只有少数学生(6%)提到雨林破坏可能助长全球变暖。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This is surprising considering the high level of media coverage on this issue.
sentences.zh: 考虑到媒体对这一问题的报道量很高,这一点令人吃惊。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Some children expressed the idea that the conservation of rainforests is not important.
sentences.zh: 一些儿童认为,保护雨林并不重要。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The results of this study suggest that certain ideas predominate in the thinking of children about rainforests.
sentences.zh: 这项研究的结果表明,儿童对雨林的思考中,某些观念占了主导地位。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Pupils’ responses indicate some misconceptions in basic scientific knowledge of rainforests’ ecosystems such as their ideas about rainforests as habitats for animals, plants and humans and the relationship between climatic change and destruction of rainforests.
sentences.zh: 学生的反应表明,在雨林生态系统的基本科学知识中存在一些误解,例如他们对雨林作为动物、植物和人类栖息地的看法,以及气候变化与雨林破坏之间的关系。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Pupils did not volunteer ideas that suggested that they appreciated the complexity of causes of rainforest destruction.
sentences.zh: 学生们并不自愿提出他们认识到雨林破坏原因的复杂性的想法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In other words, they gave no indication of an appreciation of either the range of ways in which rainforests are important or the complex social, economic and political factors which drive the activities which are destroying the rainforests.
sentences.zh: 换言之,它们没有表示对雨林的重要性方式的赞赏,也没有表示对驱使破坏雨林活动的各种复杂的社会、经济和政治因素的赞赏。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: One encouragement is that the results of similar studies about other environmental issues suggest that older children seem to acquire the ability to appreciate, value and evaluate conflicting views.
sentences.zh: 一种鼓励是,关于其他环境问题的类似研究结果表明,年龄较大的儿童似乎有能力理解、重视和评价相互冲突的观点。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Environmental education offers an arena in which these skills can be developed, which is essential for these children as future decision – makers.
sentences.zh: 环境教育为发展这些技能提供了一个舞台,对于这些儿童作为未来的决策者来说,这是至关重要的。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

items.prompt: The plight of the rainforests has largely been ignored by the media.
Children only accept opinions on rainforests that they encounter in their classrooms.
It has been suggested that children hold mistaken views about the ‘pure’ science that they study at school.
The fact that children’s ideas about science form part of a larger framework of ideas means that it is easier to change them.
The study involved asking children a number of yes/no questions such as ‘Are there any rainforests in Africa?’
Girls are more likely than boys to hold mistaken views about the rainforests’ destruction.
The study reported here follows on from a series of studies that have looked at children’s understanding of rainforests.
A second study has been planned to investigate primary school children’s ideas about rainforests.
What was the children’s most frequent response when asked where the rainforests were?
What was the most common response to the question about the importance of the rainforests?
What did most children give as the reason for the loss of the rainforests?
Why did most children think it important for the rainforests to be protected?
Which of the responses is cited as unexpectedly uncommon, given the amount of time spent on the issue by the newspapers and television?
Which of the following is the most suitable title for Reading Passage 1?
